facts.fact: Ministry of Health authors state that TB data are reported monthly by health facilities as aggregated data from paper registers and then entered into DHIS2, the level at which it is keyed not being named; during the June to November 2024 pilot the 11 sites' paper registers continued to generate the monthly reports submitted into the DHIS2 aggregate system.

systems.tiers: monthly aggregate reports from health facilities

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, National Leprosy and Tuberculosis Control Programme, with WHO-TDR funding for the study
systems.tiers: pilot at 11 TB treatment sites, June to November 2024: general and district hospitals, one health centre and one community clinic, across all seven regions

note: The value district is the nearest list value: the paper says facility paper reports are 'then entered' into DHIS2 without naming who keys them or where; the parent should check it. Everything else concerns the TB e-Tracker, a one-programme patient-level tracker, which gives no fact.
